id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying when the source server is out of disk space

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability and recovery: P1.F1.H1 distinguishes database-side disk exhaustion (terminal, non-retryable) from worker-side disk issues, while P1.F2.H1 adds tests for these error patterns including non-English locales.
review.reason: Adds MySQL/MariaDB disk-space error patterns to non-retryable set; distinguishes customer-side disk-full from worker-side OSError. Adds tests for MySQL/MariaDB disk-space errors and worker-side disk-full, including non-English locale variants.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of a substantive, bounded correctness improvement and test coverage. However, the actual runtime benefit and the complete implementation of the error handling and recovery paths are not fully demonstrated in the supplied hunk excerpts, which rely on unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are used; no score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit is inferred. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds MySQL/MariaDB disk-space error patterns to non-retryable set; distinguishes customer-side disk-full from worker-side OSError.
observations.code_quote: "OS errno 28 -": "Your MySQL/MariaDB server ran out of disk space while writing a temporary file for this sync ('No space left on device'). Syncing a large table can spill a big sort to the server's temporary directory. Free up disk space on your database server, add an index on this table's incremental field so the sync avoids the large sort, or switch the table to a full re-sync, then resync.",
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion: MySQL/MariaDB connector treats disk-space exhaustion on the database server as a terminal, non-retryable failure, while retaining retry for worker-side disk issues.

observations.behavior: Adds tests for MySQL/MariaDB disk-space errors and worker-side disk-full, including non-English locale variants.
